briefing.text: Information Technology still leads sector attention on News (buzz 87.4, +0.4 on the day, -0.5 over the week; mentions -14%; sentiment 0.14), driven by NVDA, MSFT, AMD, AVGO and CRWV. Financials fell the most on News: buzz 80.4, down 5.9 on the day and 6.2 on the week, dropping from rank 2 to 7 even though mentions rose 15% (BAC, UBS, MS, GS, C). On X, Information Technology is flat at 93.4 (NVDA, AMD, MU), while Healthcare buzz jumped 15.9 on a 200% rise in mentions (small-cap names STLN, APMD, LTGO) and Consumer Staples mentions rose 26% (TGT, HIMS, WMT). On Reddit, Information Technology is still on top at 94.1 (buzz -0.8, mentions -24%, sentiment -0.02), with Energy up 3.5 (BP, NOV, GEV) and Real Estate up 1.6.

TTWO #1: GTA VI coverage dominates (126 articles in 2 days, 65 positive vs 9 negative); it explains the attention, even with the stock down 3.6% on the day.
KLAR #2: a MarketBeat note on an analyst downgrade with shares down about 6.3%; the 3.8-sigma move explains the rank.
SILVER #3: Benzinga pieces on gold and silver stocks dropping and Fed rate fears; only 3 articles, so the news is thin and X chatter does more of the work.
DJI #4: headlines about the Alphabet move and tech being the only sector higher while defensives fell; light news, FOMC Dec 9 is the catalyst.
GOLD #5: gold stocks falling and an IRA-scam story; modest news, the rank comes from attention on Reddit and X.
TGT #6: BNP Paribas Exane reiterated underperform with a $130 target; 74 articles, 50 positive, which fits the very high attention.
NVDA #7: 1,790 articles, with Wall Street ending sharply lower as Anthropic's debut failed to revive AI fervor and class-action reminders; volume (2.3x normal) is what lifts it.
DIS #8: Morgan Stanley raised its target to $138 with an overweight rating; supportive but not a big driver of the rank.

TTWO ranks first with attention 1.48x and X attention 1.45x normal and volume 1.36x normal, though the stock is down 3.6% on the day and 8.4% over 5 days. KLAR is second mainly on a 3.8-sigma price move (down 12.4% on the day), attention 1.09x and X attention 1.25x normal, with a Kalshi KPI market resolving as the catalyst. SILVER is third on attention 1.26x and X attention 1.30x normal; its volume is only 0.13x normal and there is no catalyst, so it ranks on chatter and a 5-day drop of 10.8%.

notes: Ranks are by the scoring of record (pick_rank, w2). Prices and moves as of the last pull of the day. Facts from public data; not investment advice.
